name: A11Y-229 / SR-112 — white-on-brand dark repair (M-52 grammar: brand→ctaFill fill swaps), a11y-qa 2026-07-31 Phase B. New file; no prior stacks touched.
_doc: PURPOSE: prove every swapped small-text site now clears WCAG AA 4.5 in BOTH themes, and record the two DELIBERATELY-KEPT brand fills as large-text passes at the 3.0 floor (ReportFlagModal submit CTA 14pt bold, HomeScreen report pill 15pt bold — Sky's mockup gate owns any change to those).
TOKENS: light brand == ctaFill == #1466E0 (the swap is byte-invisible in light). Dark brand #4E89EF (the 3.42 pair, now reserved for large text + non-text UI); ctaFill MODE-INDEPENDENT #1466E0.

SWAPPED SITES (all opaque fills, white ink): NearbyFlagsModal chipActive · ReportFlagModal pillActive (category pills) · MyReportsModal sortChipActive + statusFilterChipAllActive · HomeScreen mapPeekHint + retryBtn · CommentBubble own-bubble fill (body 14pt regular + mono timestamp ride the same pair).

ALSO RECORDED: dark ctaFillPressed #0F53BE (the pressed companion several of these sites use) and the 1.4.11 3.0 rows for the icon-only brand fills Phase A verified as passing (Profile avatar disc, Tasks selectCheckOn) so the whole SR-112 question is closed in one file.
